review_output: {"summary":"Read-only review of the LINE template path; tests were not run. Tenant scoping and personal-data handling look correct, encrypted payloads are kept, and order/commission/automation messages are unchanged. Most serious issue (high): registration confirmations are backfilled. When no template exists nothing is recorded, so creating or re-enabling a LINE registration_confirmed template, or deploying with one already saved, sends confirmations to every linked, verified registrant of an upcoming live. That contradicts the 'no backfill' contract and the form wording. Medium: the send-time check doesn't confirm the event is still the same, so reminders for a rescheduled live (or a restarted live) can go out with stale times. Medium: the 'template changed' check compares edit time with delivery creation time, which a race or server clock skew can defeat, so edited copy can still be sent. Medium: templates that expand past 5×5000 characters stop all sends for that event with no warning. Medium: blocked deletes likely break deleting a used template. Low: changing a template's channel or event brings back an older one; splitting can break multi-part emoji and URLs; Email + live_started is accepted on the server; empty notifications can be queued. Sandbox delivery and WP04 remain unverified.","findings":[{"issue":"Configuring or re-enabling a LINE registration_confirmed template backfills confirmations to every existing upcoming verified registrant","file":"src/lib/line-notification-materializer.ts","recommended_fix":"Gate confirmation materialization on the registration (or LINE link) being newer than the template's activation, e.g. require submission.createdAt/verifiedAt (or identity.createdAt) >= template.updatedAt, or persist a terminal 'not_configured'/'skipped' delivery row under the stable key when no active template exists so later configuration cannot backfill. Apply the same rule to re-activation after an inactive period. Update the UI copy if any intentional linking-time send remains.","severity":"high","confidence":0.85,"area":"Usability / no-backfill contract / unintended bulk messaging","impact":"A merchant who creates the confirmation template, re-enables it after disabling, or has one saved at deploy time immediately mass-pushes 'registration confirmed' messages to all linked registrants of every upcoming live, including people who registered long ago. This breaks the stated no-backfill behaviour, contradicts the UI text, and uses up paid LINE message quota.","evidence":"The materializer calls enqueue for registration_confirmed on every cycle with requireTemplate:true. When there is no template, enqueue returns not_configured; when the template is inactive or renders to null, it returns template_disabled_or_invalid. In both cases no lineDelivery row is created, so the stable key ['registration_confirmed', subjectId] is never consumed. On the next cycle after a template becomes active, create succeeds for every eligible identity. The UI says '更改模板會停止已排入佇列的舊通知，不會補發'.","required_test":"Integration test: verified, linked registration for an upcoming live; run the materializer with no template (nothing queued); save an active LINE confirmation template; run the materializer again and assert no delivery is queued for the pre-existing registration, while a registration created after the template is confirmed. Repeat for inactive→active, and for a deploy with a pre-existing template."},{"issue":"Worker source-eligibility check does not bind the delivery to its event instance, so stale reminder/started copy can be sent after a reschedule or restart","file":"src/lib/line-notification.ts","recommended_fix":"In the webinar branch, also select live.id and compare current.idempotencyKey with stableLineIdempotencyKey(['live_reminder', live.id, subjectId, live.scheduledAt]), (['live_started', live.id, subjectId, live.startedAt]) or (['registration_confirmed', subjectId]) for the delivery's trigger. Suppress with a distinct code (e.g. line_event_changed) on mismatch. No schema change is needed.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.8,"area":"Source eligibility before send / stale content","impact":"A reminder queued or backing off before a reschedule (retry backoff can reach 60 minutes) is still sent with the old live_start_at text. The new key for the new time then sends a second reminder. A live_started retry from an earlier start session can also be sent after a restart. Registrants get wrong or duplicated times.","evidence":"The eligibility check only tests live.status/startedAt/endedAt and scheduledAt > now. The reminder key includes live.scheduledAt and the started key includes live.startedAt, but the worker never compares those values with the current live. The payload is pre-rendered with live_start_at at enqueue time.","required_test":"Queue a live_reminder, fail it once (provider 500), change live.scheduledAt to a later time still in the future, advance to the retry, and assert the old delivery is suppressed and only the new-key reminder is sent. Same for live_started across stop/restart with a new startedAt."},{"issue":"Template staleness detection uses updatedAt > delivery.createdAt, which a race or cross-instance clock skew defeats","file":"src/lib/line-notification.ts","recommended_fix":"Bind the rendered payload to the exact template version. Store template.updatedAt (or a content hash) inside the encrypted payload envelope (e.g. {v:2, templateUpdatedAt, messages}, keeping safeMessages backward-compatible) and require equality with the current template at send time. Alternatively, after lineDelivery.create in enqueue, re-read the template and suppress the row if id or updatedAt differ from the rendered one.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.7,"area":"Stale selection/content race","impact":"If a merchant edits a template between enqueue's findLineWebinarTemplate and lineDelivery.create, or the editing server's clock runs behind the materializer's, the edited template's updatedAt is ≤ createdAt. The old rendered copy is then sent even though the contract says edits cancel queued stale copy.","evidence":"The worker suppresses only when template.updatedAt > current.createdAt (or the id differs). Enqueue renders from a template read earlier, separately from the insert, with no transaction or version capture. updatedAt and createdAt are written by different processes.","required_test":"Unit test using a fake DB: enqueue reads template version T0; simulate an edit setting updatedAt to a value earlier than the delivery's createdAt before the create; assert the worker suppresses with line_template_changed. Also test edit and enqueue within the same millisecond."},{"issue":"Templates whose rendered output exceeds 5×5000 UTF-16 units silently stop all notifications for that trigger","file":"src/lib/line-webinar-template.ts","recommended_fix":"At save time (upsertTemplateAction / normalize for channel=line), render with worst-case variable lengths (max URL, title, name and vendor lengths) and reject with a specific error if more than 5 chunks would be needed. Show the limit in the UI. Return a distinct status (e.g. template_too_long) and capture it operationally instead of folding it into template_disabled_or_invalid.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.7,"area":"Usability regression / silent delivery failure","impact":"A body under the 20,000-character save limit can still expand past 25,000 units through repeated {{live_url}} or other variables (or the appended footer). Every registrant then gets nothing, the merchant gets no warning, and the only trace is an internal status that isn't persisted.","evidence":"buildLineWebinarMessages returns null when chunks.length > 5. Enqueue maps that to {status:'template_disabled_or_invalid'} without creating a row. The materializer filters out non-queued confirmation results. Save validation checks only raw body length (20,000) and variable names.","required_test":"Save a LINE template whose body repeats {{live_url}} enough to exceed 25,000 rendered units; assert save is rejected with a clear error (or, at minimum, a visible operational signal). Boundary test: exactly 25,000 units yields 5 messages each ≤5000 units."},{"issue":"onDelete Restrict on sourceTemplateId makes used LINE templates undeletable and blocks returning to legacy reminders","file":"src/lib/line-notification.ts","recommended_fix":"Have the template delete action catch P2003 and show a clear message suggesting 'disable' instead, or disable deletion in the UI for used LINE templates. Document that deleting is not the way to restore legacy behaviour. Alternatively, archive templates (a soft-delete flag already within the schema, if available).","severity":"medium","confidence":0.5,"area":"Usability regression","impact":"Once any delivery references a template, deleting it likely fails with a foreign-key error (an unhandled 500 or generic failure). Merchants also lose the only route back to the legacy reminder/started flex (no LINE template), because an inactive template suppresses sends rather than falling back.","evidence":"enqueue sets sourceTemplateId = template.id. Per the packet, the composite relation is onDelete Restrict. Legacy fallback applies only when findLineWebinarTemplate returns null. The delete action was not supplied, so its handling is unverified.","required_test":"Send a templated LINE reminder, then call the template delete action; assert a friendly, handled error (no 500) and that the template and delivery history stay intact."},{"issue":"Changing a template's channel or trigger silently resurrects an older LINE template as authoritative","file":"src/lib/line-webinar-template.ts","recommended_fix":"When a LINE template is moved off channel=line or to a different trigger, warn in the UI that the next-most-recent LINE template (or the legacy default) will take effect. Or record per-trigger selection explicitly, e.g. by touching or deactivating the predecessor in the same transaction.","severity":"low","confidence":0.55,"area":"Stale selection / usability","impact":"A merchant who converts their current LINE reminder template to Email, or retargets it, unexpectedly reactivates an older, possibly outdated, active LINE template for all lives, or reverts to legacy copy. The form gives no indication.","evidence":"findLineWebinarTemplate filters channel:'line' and trigger, ordered by updatedAt desc. A row leaving that filter drops out of selection, and the next-latest row becomes authoritative.","required_test":"With templates A (older, active) and B (newer, active) for line/live_reminder, change B's channel to email; assert the documented behaviour (A selected and the UI warned, or no LINE copy used), and that queued B deliveries are suppressed."},{"issue":"Chunking splits grapheme clusters (ZWJ emoji, flags, skin tones, keycaps) and URLs across message objects","file":"src/lib/line-webinar-template.ts","recommended_fix":"Iterate with Intl.Segmenter(undefined, {granularity:'grapheme'}), preferring breaks at the last '\\n' or whitespace before the 5000 limit. Fall back to a grapheme boundary only when no whitespace exists, and never split inside a URL token.","severity":"low","confidence":0.75,"area":"Copy preservation","impact":"for..of iterates code points, so surrogate pairs are kept, but multi-code-point emoji (👨‍👩‍👧, 🇹🇼, 👍🏽) can be split across two LINE bubbles and render broken. A live_url crossing a boundary becomes unclickable. This conflicts with the 'preserve copy/emoji' requirement.","evidence":"`for (const character of text) { if (chunk.length + character.length > 5000) {...} }` only treats code points as indivisible.","required_test":"Build text so a ZWJ family emoji, a flag pair and an https URL straddle position 5000; assert every chunk is ≤5000 UTF-16 units, the joined chunks equal the original, and no grapheme or URL is split."},{"issue":"Server-side validation accepts channel=email with trigger=live_started, which nothing sends","file":"src/lib/message-template.ts","recommended_fix":"In normalizeMessageTemplateDraft, reject channel 'email' with trigger 'live_started' (mirroring the client), and keep the server as the source of truth for the allowed channel/trigger matrix.","severity":"low","confidence":0.6,"area":"Usability / validation consistency","impact":"A crafted or stale form post can save an email live_started template that appears configured but never fires, which misleads the merchant.","evidence":"MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_TRIGGERS now includes 'live_started'. Only the client disables it for email, and normalize only restricts the LINE trigger set.","required_test":"Call upsertTemplateAction with channel=email, trigger=live_started; assert it returns invalid_template."},{"issue":"Enqueue accepts empty or zero-length message lists when the template branch doesn't run","file":"src/lib/line-notification.ts","recommended_fix":"After template resolution, throw (or return not_configured) if messages.length is 0 or greater than 5. Reject requireTemplate when the trigger isn't a webinar template trigger or templateVariables is missing.","severity":"low","confidence":0.6,"area":"Defensive correctness / retry behaviour","impact":"A future caller passing requireTemplate:true for a non-webinar trigger, or omitting templateVariables, with messages: [] creates a row. safeMessages then throws on every attempt and the row retries until exhausted, mislabelled as provider_failed.","evidence":"The confirmation caller passes messages: [] and relies on the template branch. Enqueue never checks messages.length before encrypting and inserting. The worker's safeMessages error lands in the generic catch block.","required_test":"Call enqueue with trigger 'order_created', requireTemplate:true, messages: []; assert it is rejected and no lineDelivery row is created."}]}
